title: Immunofluorescence staining for studying histone deubiquitination
protocol: Treat HeLa cells (70–80% confluence) with nocodazole (400 ng/ml, Sigma) overnight.
Collect treated cells by trypsinization.
Resuspend cells in hypotonic buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 10 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2) and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 1/10 volume of 3% Tween 20 to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge cells onto Superfrost slides using a Shandon Cytospin3 (Shandon, UK) for 5 min at 1000 rpm.
Incubate slides with KCM-T solution (containing 0.1% Triton X-100) at RT for 10 min.
Wash slides with KCM-T buffer without Triton X-100 three times.
Fix cells in freshly prepared 4% para-formaldehyde (in PBS, pH 7.4) at RT for 10 min.
Wash slides with KCM-T buffer three times.
Block slides with KCM-T buffer containing 2.5% BSA and 10% goat serum at RT for 30 min.
Incubate slides with primary antibodies (Anti-phospho-Histone H3-Ser10, Anti-ubiquityl-Histone H2A) at RT for 1 h.
Wash slides with KCM-T buffer three times.
Incubate slides with secondary antibodies (FITC conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG, Texas Red conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG) at 1:500 dilutions for an additional hour.
Wash the slides with KCM-T three times.
Wash the slides with PBS once.
Add DAPI at a concentration of 0.5 μg/ml and incubate for 1 min.
Wash the slides with PBS twice.
Wash the slides with water once.
Mount the slides with vectorshield mounting media.
Capture images with an Olympus microscope using a 20× objective.
